summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a (ControlType, str) member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, which buffers the control and returns True only when is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title) once; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200; tests added in tests/test_control.py, tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Verification was by reading only; the tests have not been run. Choices: set_window_title gates only on is_terminal, as specified, and the console test skip mirrors the existing win32 skip pattern.
